verdict.rationale: Otter ships its own Public API (Enterprise-only, API-key auth, /v1). It offers programmatic retrieval of channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines and workspace details. An MCP server also exposes search and recap. However, the documented surface is retrieval-oriented and falls well short of UI parity: there is no documented API for recording, scheduling the notetaker, uploading or importing files, editing notes, managing sharing, or using AI Chat. missing for 10: write/control endpoints matching UI actions (record, schedule bot, upload, edit, share, chat), a documented parity claim, a machine-readable spec or full reference, availability beyond Enterprise, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Otter's Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details
Custom Integrations with Otter's Public API: Otter meeting data connects to any system, including niche CRMs and proprietary platforms
